title: Create Balanced Coins [Deco + Molten]
description: Adds a more balanced and mid/late game focus on creating currency for create modpacks
body:
# Create Deco Coins
Have you ever wanted to use the coins that Create:Deco adds but felt like it was WAY too easy for those coins to be made?

**Create Balanced Coins** fixes that issue by making it where now coins are a sequenced recipe that you must have an established metal industry and established power and systems for these coins to be made properlly. 

The value of the coin is an amplified version of the one below, with there now being 3 categories of coins

**EASY** [1 cycle] 90% failure
- Copper
- Zinc

**MEDIUM** [2 cycles] 70% failure
- Iron
- Gold

**HARD** [3 cycles] 50% failrue
- Brass
- Industrial
- Netherite


This datapack was intentially made for [Celeste Create Hell] modpack but was put as a standalone due to friends asking to use it in there own modpacks! So here you go :)
